episodes.title: The Yoga Retreat That Turned Into a Cult with Alexa Jay | The Casey Graves Podcast #30
episodes.description:
3Alexa Jay joins the podcast for a conversation about growing up together, Costa Rica, relationships, spirituality, Reiki, Kundalini, dangerous men and some of the craziest situations she’s found herself in throughout her life.

Alexa and I have known each other since grade school, so this isn’t your typical guest interview. We already know each other, but somewhere along the way her life took a few turns I definitely never saw coming. We get into her traveling to Costa Rica for what she thought was a yoga retreat that slowly turned into something much more like a cult, falling in and out of love with dangerous men, finding herself in situations where she faced serious harm and somehow getting out on the other side to tell the story.

We also talk about Reiki, Kundalini practice, spirituality, relationships, healing, trusting the wrong people, following your intuition and how everything she went through changed the way she looks at life now.

This is Alexa Jay.
